# Awesome GitHub

Machine-readable index for the public site.

- `/` - Home
- `/why-this-exists/` - Why this exists
- `/references/` - References
- `/agents/` - Agent guides

## Notes

- The public site focuses on the repository structure, agent guides, and supporting references.
- Additional pages can be added without changing the shared shell.
